stories.title: Anthropic publishes new interpretability research on tracing model reasoning
stories.blurb: New research traces how large language models plan several steps ahead before generating a response, offering a clearer window into model internals than prior attribution methods.

stories.title: New arXiv preprint benchmarks reasoning models on multi-step scientific problem solving
stories.blurb: Researchers introduce a new benchmark suite testing whether frontier reasoning models can chain multiple scientific facts together without hallucinating intermediate steps.

stories.title: OpenAI rolls out updated multimodal model with faster tool-calling
stories.blurb: The update focuses on lower latency for agentic workflows, letting the model call external tools mid-response instead of waiting for full generation.

stories.title: Open-source robotics foundation model trends on GitHub
stories.blurb: A new open-weights model for humanoid robot control is climbing GitHub's trending page, with contributors reporting it works on off-the-shelf robotic arms.

stories.title: Hacker News debates the tradeoffs of the latest open-weight model release
stories.blurb: Trending on Hacker News with 540 points and 310 comments, the thread weighs licensing terms against raw benchmark performance for the newest open-weight release.

stories.title: Google DeepMind details progress on video-generation world models
stories.blurb: DeepMind researchers describe how newer world models simulate physical interactions across longer video sequences with fewer artifacts.

stories.title: r/MachineLearning discusses whether synthetic data scaling has plateaued
stories.blurb: A widely upvoted discussion on r/MachineLearning breaks down recent papers questioning how much further synthetic-data training can push benchmark gains.

stories.title: Mistral AI announces new lightweight model tuned for on-device inference
stories.blurb: The release targets phones and laptops directly, trading some benchmark performance for a footprint small enough to run fully offline.

stories.title: Venture funding for applied-AI startups climbs again this quarter
stories.blurb: Industry trackers report another jump in early-stage funding for startups applying foundation models to vertical-specific workflows.

stories.title: Hugging Face highlights community fine-tunes climbing the open leaderboard
stories.blurb: This week's roundup covers several community fine-tunes that jumped the open leaderboard rankings using new efficient training recipes.
